// Copyright 2026 The Pulse Authors. BSD-3-Clause, as the adjacent Go-LICENSE.
// Unicode data comes from Go 1.27.3 (Unicode 17.0.0). No regex runtime is copied.
// Run in a module requiring github.com/grafana/regexp
// v0.0.0-20250905093917-f7b3be9d1853. Modes: tables, fixtures.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"regexp/syntax"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"

	"github.com/grafana/regexp"
)

func main() {
	if runtime.Version() != "go1.27.3" || unicode.Version != "17.0.0" {
		panic("requires Go 1.27.3 / Unicode 17.0.0")
	}
	names := []string{"Any", "ASCII", "Assigned"}
	aliases := map[string][]string{}
	for name := range unicode.Categories {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	for name := range unicode.Scripts {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	for name, actual := range unicode.CategoryAliases {
		aliases[actual] = append(aliases[actual], canonical(name))
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "tables" {
		fmt.Println("// Generated by test/fixtures/regex/unicode-properties-producer.go.txt tables.")
		fmt.Println("// Go 1.27.3 / Unicode 17.0.0, BSD-3-Clause (test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/Go-LICENSE).")
		fmt.Println("// grafana/regexp f7b3be9d1853 uses the standard-library parser; scalar ranges only.")
		fmt.Println("type Ranges = &'static [(char, char)];")
		fmt.Println("pub(super) fn ranges(name: &str) -> Option<(Ranges, Ranges)> {")
		fmt.Println("    Some(match name {")
		for _, name := range names {
			var table, fold *unicode.RangeTable
			if name == "Any" {
				table = &unicode.RangeTable{R32: []unicode.Range32{{Lo: 0, Hi: unicode.MaxRune, Stride: 1}}}
			} else if name == "ASCII" {
				table = &unicode.RangeTable{R16: []unicode.Range16{{Lo: 0, Hi: 127, Stride: 1}}}
				fold = &unicode.RangeTable{R16: []unicode.Range16{{Lo: 0x17f, Hi: 0x17f, Stride: 1}, {Lo: 0x212a, Hi: 0x212a, Stride: 1}}}
			} else if name == "Assigned" {
				tree, _ := syntax.Parse(`\p{Assigned}`, syntax.Perl)
				table = &unicode.RangeTable{}
				for i := 0; i < len(tree.Rune); i += 2 {
					table.R32 = append(table.R32, unicode.Range32{Lo: uint32(tree.Rune[i]), Hi: uint32(tree.Rune[i+1]), Stride: 1})
				}
			} else if table = unicode.Categories[name]; table != nil {
				fold = unicode.FoldCategory[name]
			} else {
				table, fold = unicode.Scripts[name], unicode.FoldScript[name]
			}
			keys := append(aliases[name], canonical(name))
			sort.Strings(keys)
			quoted := []string{}
			for i, key := range keys {
				if i == 0 || key != keys[i-1] {
					quoted = append(quoted, fmt.Sprintf("%q", key))
				}
			}
			fmt.Printf("        %s => (&[%s], &[%s]),\n", strings.Join(quoted, " | "), ranges(table), ranges(fold))
		}
		fmt.Println("        _ => return None,\n    })\n}")
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) != 2 || os.Args[1] != "fixtures" {
		panic("expected tables or fixtures")
	}
	patterns := []string{}
	// Every canonical name, both signs, with/without folding. These are local
	// executed controls, not additional upstream integration-test rows.
	for _, name := range names {
		for _, prefix := range []string{"", "(?i)"} {
			for _, sign := range []string{"p", "P"} {
				patterns = append(patterns, prefix+`\`+sign+`{`+name+`}`)
			}
		}
	}
	// Includes all 22 original property patterns at Go parse_test.go:99-120.
	// The fork's root regexp package imports standard-library
	// regexp/syntax, NOT its own stale syntax directory. Exercise that path.
	patterns = append(patterns,
		`\p{Braille}`, `\P{Braille}`, `\p{^Braille}`, `\P{^Braille}`, `\pZ`,
		`[\p{Braille}]`, `[\P{Braille}]`, `[\p{^Braille}]`, `[\P{^Braille}]`,
		`[\pZ]`, `\p{__upper case-let ter}`, `[\p{Lu}]`, `(?i)[\p{Lu}]`,
		`\p{^Any}`, `(?i)\p{ascii}`, `\p{^Assigned}`,
		`\p{latin}`, `\p{LATIN}`, `\p{Latn}`, `\p{Greek }`, `\p{Old-Italic}`,
		`\p{Uppercase_Letter}`, `\p{upper case-let ter}`, `\p{ASCII}`, `\p{Assigned}`,
		`\p{Cn}`, `\p{LC}`, `\p{Zyyy}`, `\p{White_Space}`, `\p{Alphabetic}`,
		`\p{Script=Latin}`, `\p{sc:Latin}`, `\p{gc=Lu}`, `\p{InGreek}`, `\p{Age=17.0}`,
		`\p{}`, `\p{^}`, `\p{^^Latin}`, `\p{Latin`, `\p{ Latin}`, `\p{Latin\t}`,
		`\p{___uPpEr CaSe---lEtTeR}`, `\p{___ c a n a d i a n - a b o r i g i n a l ___}`,
		`\p{ ^Latin}`, `\p{Latin`+"\t"+`}`, `\p{Latin`+"\u00a0"+`}`, `\p{Latin:}`,
		`\p{Letter}{0}(?P<piece>\p{upper case-letter})`, `\p{NotAScript}{0}`,
		`[\p{Beria_Erfe}\p{Tolong_Siki}]`, `[^\P{Tai_Yo}]`, `\P{^Sidetic}{2}`,
		`(?i)[\P{Lu}k]`, `(?i)[^\p{Lu}]`, `(?i)\p{Lu}(?-i:\p{Lu})\p{Lu}`,
		`(?i:\p{Lu})\p{Lu}`, `(?P<piece>\p{Lu}+)(?P<tail>\P{Lu}*)`,
		`\p{Latin}+(?i)?`, `\Q\p{Invalid}\E`, `\\p{Latin}`, `[a-\pL]`,
		`(?i)[\p{LC}]`, `(?i)[^\p{LC}]`, `(?i)[\P{LC}α]`, `(?i)[^\P{LC}α]`,
		`(?i)[\p{LC}x\p{Mn}]`, `(?i)[^\p{LC}x\p{Mn}]`, `(?i)\p{LC}(?-i:\p{LC})`,
		`[\P{Any}]`, `[^\p{Any}]`, `[^\p{Private_Use}\x{d7ff}]`,
	)
	for name := range unicode.CategoryAliases {
		patterns = append(patterns, `\p{`+name+`}`)
	}
	// Sort map-derived additions for byte-identical regeneration.
	sort.Strings(patterns)
	inputs := []string{"", "x", "X", "k", "K", "ſ", "α", "Α", "é", "É", "1", "٣", "_", " ", "\n", "\x00", "\u2800", "\u28ff", "🙂", "\u0378", "\ufffd", "\U0010ffff",
		"\u0345", "\u0399", "\u03b9", "\ud7fe", "\ud7ff", "\ue000", "\ue001", "\u0345\u0399", "\u0399\u0399",
		"\u1c89", "\u1c8a", "\ua7ce", "\ua7cf", "\ua7d2", "\ua7d4", "\U00016ea0", "\U00016ebb", "\U00016ebc", "\U00011db0", "\U00011de0", "\U00010940", "\U0001e6c0", "\U0002ee5d", "\U0002ee5e", "\U00033479", "\U0003347a", "XxX", "Xx", "XX", "xxx", `\p{Invalid}`, `\p{Latin}`}
	httpPatterns := map[string]bool{}
	for _, pattern := range []string{`\p{latin}`, `\p{LATIN}`, `\p{Uppercase_Letter}`, `\p{upper case-let ter}`, `\p{Old-Italic}`,
		`(?i)[\P{Lu}k]`, `(?i)[^\p{Lu}]`, `(?i)\p{Lu}(?-i:\p{Lu})\p{Lu}`, `(?i:\p{Lu})\p{Lu}`,
		`(?i)[\p{LC}]`, `(?i)[^\p{LC}]`, `(?i)[\P{LC}α]`, `(?i)[^\P{LC}α]`,
		`(?i)[\p{LC}x\p{Mn}]`, `(?i)[^\p{LC}x\p{Mn}]`, `[\P{Any}]`, `[^\p{Any}]`,
		`[^\p{Private_Use}\x{d7ff}]`,
		`[\p{Beria_Erfe}\p{Tolong_Siki}]`, `[^\P{Tai_Yo}]`, `\P{^Sidetic}{2}`} {
		httpPatterns[pattern] = true
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Lu", "Cn", "ASCII", "Assigned", "Latin", "Beria_Erfe"} {
		for _, prefix := range []string{"", "(?i)"} {
			for _, sign := range []string{"p", "P"} {
				httpPatterns[prefix+`\`+sign+`{`+name+`}`] = true
			}
		}
	}
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, pattern := range patterns {
		re, err := regexp.Compile(pattern)
		row := map[string]any{"pattern": pattern, "valid": err == nil, "http": err != nil || httpPatterns[pattern]}
		if err == nil {
			tree, err := syntax.Parse(pattern, syntax.Perl|syntax.DotNL)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			full := regexp.MustCompile(`\A(?:` + tree.String() + `)\z`)
			values := []map[string]any{}
			for _, text := range inputs {
				value := map[string]any{"text": text, "repeat": 1, "match": re.MatchString(text), "label_match": full.MatchString(text)}
				if re.NumSubexp() > 0 {
					var captures map[string]string
					if match := full.FindStringSubmatchIndex(text); match != nil {
						captures = map[string]string{}
						for index := 0; index <= re.NumSubexp(); index++ {
							key := strconv.Itoa(index)
							captures[key] = string(full.ExpandString(nil, "${"+key+"}", text, match))
						}
						for _, name := range re.SubexpNames() {
							if name != "" {
								captures[name] = string(full.ExpandString(nil, "${"+name+"}", text, match))
							}
						}
					}
					value["captures"] = captures
				}
				values = append(values, value)
			}
			row["values"] = values
		}
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"go": runtime.Version(), "unicode": unicode.Version, "regexp": "github.com/grafana/regexp@v0.0.0-20250905093917-f7b3be9d1853", "cases": rows})
}

func canonical(name string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(strings.NewReplacer("_", "", "-", "", " ", "").Replace(name))
}

// Coalesce Unicode tables, including strided entries, into scalar intervals.
// Surrogates are not Rust/UTF-8 scalar values; exclude them, never change the
// meaning of Cs on valid UTF-8. This is data generation, not matching code.
func ranges(table *unicode.RangeTable) string {
	if table == nil {
		return ""
	}
	var out strings.Builder
	var lo, hi rune = -1, -1
	flush := func() {
		if lo >= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(&out, "('\\u{%x}', '\\u{%x}'),", lo, hi)
		}
	}
	for r := rune(0); r <= unicode.MaxRune; r++ {
		if r >= 0xd800 && r <= 0xdfff || !unicode.Is(table, r) {
			continue
		}
		if (r == hi+1 || hi == 0xd7ff && r == 0xe000) && lo >= 0 {
			hi = r
		} else {
			flush()
			lo, hi = r, r
		}
	}
	flush()
	return out.String()
}
